title: Degreewise coordinates of the cokernel of successive upper truncations
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K$ a cochain complex [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $q\in\mathbf Z$. Write $T_n=\tau_{\le n}K$ for the canonical upper truncation, whose terms are $K^r$ for $r<n$, $\ker d^n$ for $r=n$, and zero for $r>n$, with inclusion $\iota_n:T_n\to K$. Let $i:T_{q-1}\to T_q$ satisfy $\iota_q i=\iota_{q-1}$, let $M=\operatorname{coker}i$, and $p:T_q\to M$ its projection. Then $M^r=0$ up to zero-object isomorphism for $r\ne q-1,q$. There are isomorphisms $e_0:M^{q-1}\cong\operatorname{coker}(\ker d^{q-1}\hookrightarrow K^{q-1})$ and $e_1:M^q\cong\ker d^q$ such that $e_0p^{q-1}=\pi\iota_q^{q-1}$, $e_1p^q$ is the canonical identification $T_q^q\cong\ker d^q$, and $(\ker d^q\hookrightarrow K^q)e_1d_M^{q-1}e_0^{-1}\pi=d_K^{q-1}$. The differential $d_M^{q-1}$ is mono. Here $\pi$ denotes the coimage projection.

proof.text: The compatibility with the inclusions into K determines i uniquely, since the latter inclusion is mono. The single proved helper truncLE_inclusion_coordinates simultaneously identifies the truncation inclusion with truncLEXIsoCycles followed by iCycles at its boundary and with truncLEXIso below the boundary, by dualizing the Mathlib truncGE component identities. Strict upper support makes the source of i.f q zero. The kernel universal property identifies cycles in degree q-1 with kernel (K.d (q - 1) q). These are the degreewise canonical truncation identifications for the complexes in the statement.

Use PreservesCokernel.iso and PreservesCokernel.π_iso_hom for HomologicalComplex.eval to identify each evaluated cokernel with cokernel (i.f r), using the Mathlib degreewise cokernel-preservation instances. At q use cokernelIsoOfEq and cokernelZeroIsoTarget; at q-1 use cokernel.mapIso with the kernel and truncation identifications. Their projection identities give he₀ and he₁. Away from the two degrees, i.f r is epi: below q-1 this follows from the two inclusion isomorphisms and hi, and above q its target is zero. Apply isZero_cokernel_of_epi.

Cancel the isomorphic degree-(q-1) truncation inclusion, substitute he₀ and he₁, and use the cokernel projection chain-map equation and the truncation inclusion chain-map equation to obtain hd. Cancel the cokernel projection and use Abelian.coimage.fac to identify e₀.inv ≫ d_M ≫ e₁.hom ≫ K.iCycles q with Abelian.factorThruCoimage (K.d (q-1) q). The Mathlib coimage-mono instance makes this composite mono. Apply mono_of_mono and cancel the source isomorphism to conclude Mono d_M.

theorem upperTruncationStep_quotientCoordinates
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (q : ℤ)
    (i : K.truncLE (q - 1) ⟶ K.truncLE q)
    (hi : i ≫ K.ιTruncLE q = K.ιTruncLE (q - 1)) :
    (∀ r : ℤ, r ≠ q - 1 → r ≠ q → IsZero ((cokernel i).X r)) ∧
    ∃ (e₀ : (cokernel i).X (q - 1) ≅ cokernel (kernel.ι (K.d (q - 1) q)))
      (e₁ : (cokernel i).X q ≅ K.cycles q),
      (cokernel.π i).f (q - 1) ≫ e₀.hom =
        (K.ιTruncLE q).f (q - 1) ≫ cokernel.π (kernel.ι (K.d (q - 1) q)) ∧
      (cokernel.π i).f q ≫ e₁.hom = (K.truncLEXIsoCycles q).hom ∧
      cokernel.π (kernel.ι (K.d (q - 1) q)) ≫ e₀.inv ≫
          (cokernel i).d (q - 1) q ≫ e₁.hom ≫ K.iCycles q = K.d (q - 1) q ∧
      Mono ((cokernel i).d (q - 1) q)
